verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right: the right-hand text column groups headline, body copy and CTA. Its flaws are that the headline is undersized for the banner, the SOLSTICE logo is tiny and a bubble cuts into it ('SO.STICE'), the CTA sits on the bubble, and the bottom band is empty. B breaks the headline badly ('Chase the / Light'), squeezes the body copy into a five-line column wedged between the can and the CTA, which jumbles the reading order. It also strands the badge and a tiny logo on the left circle, so the composition looks scattered.
